enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +14 (Equipment bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +7 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Competence Elemental Resistance - 5: This item provides a +5 Competence bonus to your Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical resistances.
Linguistics: This item reduced the cooldowns of your Social skills (Diplomacy, Bluff, Intimidate) by 15%. This does not stack with the Negotiator ability.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
